hooks.name: Copy to Deploy
hooks.description: Copy POWER.md, README.md, mcp.json and steering/*.md to the deploy folder when edited, then remove .DS_Store files. The matcher is anchored to this workspace's absolute path: the previous matcher was anchored only at the end ($), so it matched any same-named file anywhere on disk and fired on files outside this repo. deploy/** is excluded automatically because the anchor requires the file to sit directly under the workspace root.

action.prompt:
A power source file in this workspace was saved. Before acting, confirm scope from the payload: `file_path` MUST begin with `cwd`, and its path relative to `cwd` MUST be exactly POWER.md, README.md or mcp.json, or match steering/<name>.md. If the relative path starts with deploy/, STOP - that is the destination, not the source. If any check fails, STOP, copy nothing, and reply in one line that the hook fired out of scope on <file_path>.

If the checks pass: copy that ONE file to deploy/<relative path>, creating parent directories if needed. Do not re-sync unrelated files. Delete any .DS_Store files under deploy/. Verify the copy with cmp and report the single file copied in one line.

Never modify the source file. This hook only copies - it must not edit README.md, POWER.md or any steering file.
